newsitem.title: USA: Dow open seen steady to higher as rally steams on.
newsitem.headline: Dow open seen steady to higher as rally steams on.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to start steady to higher on Tuesday a day after piercing the 6500 level for the first time ever.

While analysts had expected some profit-taking to emerge during Monday's session, the Dow plowed ahead by more than 76 points to its 12th record close this month, leaving few on Wall Street willing to stand in the way of the current run.
"It's just unrelenting," said Larry Wachtel, market analyst at Prudential Securities. "It's very difficult to make the call that suddenly it's going to stop."
